notes: Published January 21, 2026 (press release; PDF created 2026-01-21). The 'Investment Opportunity Report 2026' (ARK Funds, April 2026) is a separate derivative publication and is not captured. No per-coin bitcoin price target appears in the text layer of this edition. Skipped: about 20 claims without a number or without a date, for example space versus terrestrial AI compute cost ratios (no year in text), capital expenditure as a share of GDP (chart only), innovation share of global equity market (chart only), Starship satellite bandwidth cost points (2026 and 2035, values not legible in text), and multiomics 2030 performance multipliers on p62.
